title: Emptying a deactivated term with Move lets it be deleted
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Create a new term of the shop's own for this test, term A, due 14 days after the invoice date.
  • Create customer A for this test on term A (no vendor or invoice uses term A).
  • Then deactivate term A.
  • Make sure Net 30 is active.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Inactive" tab.
  2. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  3. Click "Move Customers".
  4. Choose "Net 30" in "Move To".
  5. Click "Move 1 Customer".
  6. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  7. Click "Delete Credit Term".
  8. Click the red "Delete Credit Term" button.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Term A is listed.

Step 2:

  • The menu shows "Reactivate", "Move Customers" and a greyed "Delete Credit Term".

Step 3:

  • The window "Move Customers from term A" opens with customer A ticked.

Step 4:

  • The dropdown shows Net 30.

Step 5:

  • The toast "1 customer moved to Net 30." shows and term A's Customers count reads 0.

Step 6:

  • "Delete Credit Term" is now available (not greyed).

Step 7:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 8:

  • The toast "term A deleted" shows and the row is gone.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-N3: “Inactive terms and Credit Hold are valid sources (Move Customers is how a shop empties a deactivated term). Inactive terms are never offered in "Move To".”
  • S4-E4: “Moving customers off a deactivated term empties it; once no customer, vendor or invoice holds a term the shop created, it can be deleted.”
